MR-1.title: Return of Appointment of MD/WTD/Manager/CEO/CFO/CS
MR-1.applies: PUBLIC COMPANIES and PRIVATE COMPANIES that are SUBSIDIARIES of Public Companies ONLY. Independent private companies EXEMPT.
MR-1.linked: MR-2 (if remuneration exceeds Schedule V limits)
MR-1.notes: Certified by practising CA/CS/Cost Accountant. Independent private companies do NOT file MR-1.
steps: Board approves appointment
Obtain DIR-2 consent + DIR-8 from appointee
Verify remuneration against Schedule V
Get CA/CS/Cost Accountant certification
File MR-1 on MCA V3 within 60 days
File MR-2 separately if excess remuneration

MGT-7.title: Annual Return
MGT-7.applies: All companies EXCEPT OPC and Small Companies (who file MGT-7A)
MGT-7.timeline: Within 60 days of AGM (by 29 Nov if AGM 30 Sep)
MGT-7.linked: MGT-7A (OPC/Small), PCS certification now embedded (MGT-8 abolished)
MGT-7.notes: New from Jul 2025: registered office photograph with director + GPS coordinates + gender-wise SH data. PCS certification embedded inside — do NOT file MGT-8 separately.
steps: Hold AGM by 30 Sep
Prepare return data
Photograph registered office with director visible
Note GPS lat/long coordinates
PCS certifies within form (if required)
File MGT-7 on MCA V3 within 60 days of AGM

MGT-7A.title: Abridged Annual Return — OPC and Small Companies
MGT-7A.applies: OPC: within 60 days of FY end. Small Company: within 60 days of AGM.
MGT-7A.timeline: OPC: by 29 May. Small Co: by 29 Nov (if AGM 30 Sep)
MGT-7A.notes: Simplified form — no PCS certification required. OPC files from FY end (no AGM required for OPC).
steps: OPC: prepare after FY end
Small Co: prepare after AGM
File MGT-7A on MCA V3 — no PCS certification needed

MGT-8.title: Certification of Annual Return by PCS
MGT-8.portal: ABOLISHED — not a separate form from July 14, 2025
MGT-8.applies: N/A — certification is now inside MGT-7
MGT-8.penalty: Filing MGT-8 separately is incorrect from July 14 2025
MGT-8.linked: MGT-7 (PCS certification is now embedded here)
MGT-8.notes: DO NOT file MGT-8 as a separate form. PCS certifies the annual return directly within MGT-7 on MCA V3 using DSC.
steps: Do NOT file MGT-8 separately
PCS certifies within MGT-7 form on MCA V3
Ensure PCS has registered DSC on MCA V3

AOC-4.title: Form for Filing Financial Statements
AOC-4.applies: All companies. AOC-4 CFS for companies with subsidiaries. OPC: AOC-4 OPC.
AOC-4.timeline: Within 30 days of AGM (by 30 Oct if AGM 30 Sep). OPC: 180 days from FY end.
AOC-4.linked: AOC-4 CFS, CSR-2 (linked), AOC-2 (linked), ADT-1 SRN required
AOC-4.notes: From Jul 2025: figures in ABSOLUTE RUPEES (not rounded). ADT-1 SRN required as input. New secretarial auditor observations table. CSR-2 is a linked filing.
steps: Board approves financial statements
Hold AGM
Collect ADT-1 SRN
Prepare AOC-4 with figures in absolute rupees
CSR-2 and AOC-2 as linked filings
File on MCA V3 within 30 days of AGM

ADT-1.title: Information to Registrar — Auditor Appointment
ADT-1.updated: July 14 2025 — new field: Audit Committee recommendation
ADT-1.applies: All companies — filed ONCE per 5-year appointment
ADT-1.timeline: Within 15 days of AGM (or Board resolution for OPC/Small Co)
ADT-1.notes: Annual ratification NOT mandatory. File once per 5-year term. New field: Audit Committee recommendation. SRN must be noted for future AOC-4.
steps: AGM appoints auditor for 5-year term
Obtain auditor consent and certificate (Sec 141)
File ADT-1 on MCA V3 within 15 days of AGM
Note SRN — needed for AOC-4
No annual refiling required

DIR-12.title: Particulars of Appointment of Directors and KMP
DIR-12.updated: Jan 23 2023 + Companies Amendment Rules 2023 (Form 9 for disqualification)
DIR-12.linked: DIR-2 (consent), DIR-8 (disqualification), DIR-11 (by resigning director), MR-1
DIR-12.notes: New: company must file Form 9 within 30 days of receiving DIR-8 (disqualification) from director. Obtain DIR-2 + DIR-8 from every incoming director.
steps: Obtain DIR-2 consent + DIR-8 from incoming director
Board approves appointment
File DIR-12 on MCA V3 within 30 days
Resignation: director files DIR-11; company also files DIR-12
Disqualification: director files DIR-8; company files Form 9 within 30 days

BEN-2.title: Return of Significant Beneficial Owners
BEN-2.applies: All companies on receiving BEN-1 from Significant Beneficial Owner
BEN-2.penalty: Rs.1 Lakh + Rs.1,000/day; shares may be disenfranchised
BEN-2.linked: BEN-1 (SBO declaration), BEN-3 (company register), BEN-4 (notice to suspected SBO)
BEN-2.notes: SBO = individual with ≥10% beneficial interest in shares/voting/dividend. Send BEN-4 to suspected SBOs proactively. Cross-verify BEN-3 with MGT-7 annually.
steps: Identify individuals with ≥10% beneficial interest
Send BEN-4 notice to suspected SBOs
Receive BEN-1 from SBO within 30 days
File BEN-2 on MCA V3 within 30 days of BEN-1
Update BEN-3 register at registered office

DPT-3.title: Return of Deposits / Outstanding Loans
DPT-3.applies: ALL companies — including NIL return (zero deposits/loans)
DPT-3.timeline: On or before 30 JUNE each year
DPT-3.notes: COMMON ERROR: Due date is 30 JUNE not 31 May. ALL companies must file — even NIL return. Reports outstanding as on 31 March.
steps: Compile all deposits/loans outstanding as on 31 March
Include NIL if nothing outstanding
File DPT-3 on MCA V3 on or before 30 June
Attach auditor certificate for deposits accepted

INC-20A.title: Declaration for Commencement of Business
INC-20A.applies: Every company with share capital incorporated on/after November 2, 2018
INC-20A.timeline: Within 180 days of incorporation — one-time filing
INC-20A.penalty: Company Rs.50,000; each director Rs.1,000/day. ROC may initiate removal.
INC-20A.notes: CRITICAL: Company CANNOT commence business or borrow money until INC-20A is filed. Bank statement required as proof of paid-up capital.
steps: Open company bank account
Subscribers deposit share subscription
Obtain bank statement showing payment
File INC-20A on MCA V3 within 180 days
Do NOT start business before filing

MSC-3.title: Annual Return for Dormant Companies
MSC-3.applies: Only companies with dormant status under Sec 455
MSC-3.timeline: On or before 31 MARCH each year — NOT September
MSC-3.penalty: Default penalty. Non-filing for 3 years: dormant status cancelled.
MSC-3.notes: COMMON MISTAKE: Due 31 MARCH not 30 September. If dormant status cancelled for non-filing, all standard compliance obligations recommence.
steps: Confirm company still qualifies as dormant
Prepare MSC-3 with updated share capital
File on MCA V3 on or before 31 March

CRA-4.title: Form of Cost Audit Report
CRA-4.applies: Companies where cost audit is applicable under Cost Audit Rules 2014
CRA-4.timeline: Within 30 days of receipt from Cost Auditor (by 30 Sep). FY 2024-25 only: extended to 31 Dec 2025.
CRA-4.penalty: Company Rs.25,000–Rs.5 Lakh; Cost Auditor: debarment
CRA-4.notes: Now in XBRL format on MCA V3. FY 2024-25 deadline extended to 31 December 2025 by MCA circular.
steps: Board appoints Cost Auditor; file CRA-2
Cost Auditor prepares report (CRA-3)
Company files CRA-4 in XBRL on MCA V3 within 30 days of receipt

MGT-14.title: Filing of Resolutions and Agreements
MGT-14.applies: All companies — for Special Resolutions and certain Board Resolutions under Sec 117
MGT-14.timeline: Within 30 days of passing the resolution
MGT-14.penalty: Company Rs.5 Lakh; officer Rs.1 Lakh
MGT-14.notes: Required for ALL Special Resolutions and Board resolutions listed in Sec 117(3). Not all BRs require MGT-14.
steps: Pass SR at EGM/AGM (or applicable BR)
Prepare certified copy of resolution
File MGT-14 on MCA V3 within 30 days
Attach agreements/documents as applicable

CHG-1.title: Application for Registration of Creation/Modification of Charge
CHG-1.applies: All companies on creation/modification of charge
CHG-1.timeline: Within 30 days (condoned to 60 days; beyond 300 days: NCLT condonation)
CHG-1.penalty: Rs.5,000 + Rs.500/day; charge may be void against liquidator
CHG-1.notes: Unregistered charge may not be enforceable in liquidation. Maintain Register of Charges (CHG-7) at registered office.
steps: Execute charge creation document
Prepare CHG-1 with asset details
File CHG-1 on MCA V3 within 30 days
Obtain charge ID from ROC
Record in CHG-7 register
File CHG-4 on satisfaction/repayment

IEPF-1.title: Statement of Amounts Credited to IEPF
IEPF-1.applies: All companies with dividend unclaimed for 7+ consecutive years
IEPF-1.timeline: On or before 31 October each year
IEPF-1.linked: IEPF-2, IEPF-4 (notice to SHs), IEPF-5 (SH claim)
IEPF-1.notes: Shares of affected shareholders must also be transferred to IEPF demat simultaneously. LODR Amendment 2026: NCD unclaimed interest/redemption also covered.
steps: Identify 7+ year unclaimed dividends
Send IEPF-4 notice by 31 July
Publish list on website by 31 August
File IEPF-2 by 30 Sep
Transfer dividend to IEPF by 31 Oct
Transfer shares to IEPF demat
File IEPF-1 by 31 Oct

INC-18.title: Application for Conversion of Section 8 Company into any Other Kind
INC-18.applies: Section 8 companies seeking conversion to Private Limited or other type
INC-18.timeline: File to Regional Director within 3 months of Special Resolution
INC-18.penalty: Conversion without RD approval void; company continues to be Section 8
INC-18.notes: CRITICAL: This is Regional Director approval — NOT NCLT. NOT SPICe+. NOT simple MoA/AoA alteration. INC-32 (SPICe+) is WRONG. Section 122 is irrelevant. Section 115TD exit tax applies if Section 12A registered. Creditor consent mandatory. Assets must be transferred to another Sec 8 company or IEPF as directed by RD.
steps: Board Resolution — approve conversion, altered MoA/AoA, fix SGM date
Pass Special Resolution at SGM — conversion + altered MoA/AoA
File MGT-14 within 30 days of SR
Within 1 week of filing application: publish INC-19 notice in 1 English + 1 vernacular newspaper
Intimate ROC, Income Tax Dept, Charity Commissioner, sectoral regulators
File INC-18 to Regional Director with: SR copy, altered MoA/AoA, audited FS, asset-liability statement, creditor list with written consent, director declaration, proof of publication
RD hearing if objections received
After RD approval order: file INC-20 within 30 days
ROC issues fresh Certificate of Incorporation as Private Limited Company
Address Section 115TD exit tax liability (if Sec 12A registered)

INC-19.title: Notice for Conversion of Section 8 Company (Newspaper Publication)
INC-19.applies: Mandatory step for Section 8 company conversion — within 1 week of filing INC-18
INC-19.timeline: Within 1 week of filing application to Regional Director
INC-19.penalty: Non-publication: application to RD may be rejected
INC-19.notes: Must be published in: (1) one English language newspaper and (2) one vernacular language newspaper — both in the principal district where RO is situated. Must also intimate: ROC, Income Tax authority, Charity Commissioner if registered, any sectoral regulator.
steps: Draft notice per Form INC-19
Publish in one English newspaper (principal district of RO)
Publish in one vernacular newspaper (principal district of RO)
Send notice to ROC
Send notice to jurisdictional Income Tax officer
Send notice to Charity Commissioner (if registered as charity)
Preserve newspaper clippings as proof
Attach proof of publication with INC-18 application

INC-20.title: Intimation of Conversion — Post Regional Director Approval
INC-20.applies: After Regional Director approves Section 8 conversion
INC-20.penalty: Late filing: additional fee; non-filing: conversion certificate not issued
INC-20.notes: Filed after RD grants approval. ROC then issues fresh Certificate of Incorporation as Private Limited Company. Company must also address compliance requirements: (1) update name (add 'Private Limited'), (2) file altered MoA/AoA, (3) comply with private company requirements going forward.
steps: Receive RD order approving conversion
File INC-20 on MCA V3 within 30 days
ROC issues fresh Certificate of Incorporation
Update company name in all records
Address tax compliance: Section 12A/80G cancellation, Section 115TD exit tax
Inform all stakeholders of conversion
Update bank accounts, contracts, licenses

PAS-3.title: Return of Allotment
PAS-3.applies: All companies on every fresh allotment of shares/securities
PAS-3.notes: Listed companies: allotment in demat form only. Private placement: requires prior SR approval + MGT-14 filing.
steps: Board approves allotment
Verify private placement SR (if applicable)
Credit shares to demat accounts
File PAS-3 on MCA V3 within 30 days
Update register of members
